items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: I went and got Basie. I stole Basie and bought Basie up to the Deluxe side to do it.

ctx.x: Oh, I stayed, I stayed, I stayed in the Deluxe three, four years or more. Then, two years and something. Because Billy Bottoms got me to come over to Dreamland, see. Just before I went to the Dreamland, uh, Basie come to Chicago with, uh, P.R. this woman who called, oh, it was already a TV time, uh, show, what's that called? Come there with a show and a heart, and I went and got Basie. I stole Basie and bought Basie up to the Deluxe side to do it.
You even know the commercial. Is that nice. Did -- did you hear Basie play with Walter Page. Do you know --
